name: Thiu
source:
One of the protagonist. An extremely shy person who is depresed and lonely almost all the time.  Tired of his situation he searched for help, but since he couldn't find any quick fix to his problems, he started looking for an illegal magical cure.
He is the individual who retained almost all of his bad emotions when his personalities were separated in two, but he could also keep his hope and intelligence.
